description: Which operations of the Ever Platform API form the instance-facing contract, and where tools/sync-contract.mjs reads them. An operation is selected when it accepts the instanceToken scheme or is listed in include_operation_ids; staff, person-session and internal routes are never selected. The pinned spec wins over the design for every operation and schema it already defines; design operations are provisional until the pinned spec carries them.

exclude_operation_ids.subscribeRealtime: the server-sent event stream serves the app.ever.co browser; installations read their events from the instance feed instead

putIntegrationState.why: the pinned contract accepts an app.ever.co session or an Ever ID token of the Ever Platform project from a fresh sign-in; contract v1 serves this operation to app.ever.co only (not_in_v1 for installations), and the SDK keeps its type with the token scheme

ConnectCode.why: the pinned contract names the connect-code resource ConnectCode; the design operations still mean the code itself (EVC-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX)
